name: claude-mobile-shell
description: Opens the Claude Code panel full-screen and strips VS Code chrome for phone use

commands.title: Mobile: Back to Claude (close open files)
Mobile: Terminal in the editor area (toggle)

enumDescriptions: Claude runs in a tmux session, shown in an editor terminal. One process per project no matter how many devices are looking at it, so a phone and a laptop join the same live run and it survives reloads, disconnects, code-server restarts and redeploys.
Claude runs in the extension's own panel. Richer UI, but the process is a child of the extension host, so every browser page gets its own copy of the conversation and two devices fork the transcript.
claudeMobile.claudeSurface.description: Where Claude runs. 'tmux' is what makes a session hand off between devices; 'panel' is the extension's UI and is single-device.

claudeMobile.closeFilesOnStartup.description: Close restored files and diffs when the workbench starts, so reloading the page recovers a layout that a file view has taken over. Turn this off to keep your open editors across reloads.
